archetypes.name: dyn-validator-strictness
archetypes.rationale: Strict no-findings prose acceptance can accidentally admit thin reviewer output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the validation-mode no-findings prose matcher and collector regression tests. Check that the accepted shape matches the shipped reviewer template while rejecting headerless, mixed, and process-narration outputs. Verify the docs do not imply arbitrary short prose is substantive. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
